data.text:
Kyatham Rajeshwar vs Sri E. Naveen Nicolas, Ias on 20
September, 2024
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice Pulla Karthik
 Contempt Case No.1006 Of 2024
Order: 
This Contempt Case is filed for alleged violation of the order passed by this Court in W.P.No.32318 of 2023, dated 01.12.2023.
2. When the matter is taken up for hearing, Sri M.Ramgopal Rao, learned Standing Counsel for Telangana State Public Service Commission, appearing for the respondent, produced the CFSL report through letter No.90/OW/DCP-DD/Hyd/2024, dated 10.07.2024, received from the office of the Deputy Commissioner of Police, Detective Department, CCS, Hyderabad, and submits that pursuant to the said CFSL report, the respondent will take all consequential steps to conclude the final selection process for the post of the Food Safety Officer (FSO) pursuant to the notification No.6/2022 dated 21.07.2022.
3. Recording the said submission, the Contempt Case is closed. No costs. 
Miscellaneous petitions if any, pending in this Contempt Case shall stand closed. 
_________________________ ______ JUSTICE PULLA KARTHIK Date: 20.09.2024 YVL Kyatham Rajeshwar vs Sri E. Naveen Nicolas, Ias on 20 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/59237899/
